job.jobDescription:
Join Microsoft as a Senior Software Engineer working on Azure cloud services. You'll design and implement scalable distributed systems that power cloud infrastructure for millions of customers worldwide.

Responsibilities:

  • Design and develop highly scalable distributed systems
  • Write clean, maintainable code following best practices
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Mentor junior engineers
  • Participate in code reviews and architectural discussions

Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of software development experience
  • Strong proficiency in C#, Java, or similar languages
  • Experience with distributed systems and microservices
  • BS/MS in Computer Science or related field
  • Excellent problem-solving skills
